name: rehydrate
description: Lets Codex recover and recheck session-wide continuity during execution.

interface.shortDescription: Recover and recheck context during active work.
interface.longDescription: Rehydrate stays inactive before context compaction, then traces relevant history from the user's initial goal through later discussion and observable assistant actions. During execution, Codex can independently recheck prior evidence whenever it could change the next action.
defaultPrompt: Use $rehydrate to trace relevant session history and recheck prior evidence during execution.
Recover the session details needed to continue this task without repeating or contradicting prior work.
